# tfcensus move suggest

suggest plans each --from and --to unit through terragrunt (one at a time, against its backend,
without the state lock) and pairs every resource a --from unit plans to delete with the resource a
--to unit plans to create. A pair is a move when the type is the same, every attribute known before
apply is equal, and neither resource matches anything else. Null equals an empty string, list or
map. Replaced resources and data sources never take part. Name a unit in both --from and --to to
find renames inside it.

--ignore lets one attribute differ, with tfautomv's syntax: everything:TYPE:ATTR,
whitespace:TYPE:ATTR, prefix:TYPE:ATTR:PREFIX, plus json:TYPE:ATTR, which compares JSON strings by
value. TYPE may be \*. ATTR is a flat key such as tags.Name or ingress.0.cidr\_blocks.#; a \* segment
matches any one segment, and a rule covers the keys below its ATTR.

The draft goes to stdout, or to --draft. It holds one migration "units" block per source unit and
one block of mv actions per unit whose addresses change. suggest writes no state; check the draft
with tfcensus move plan. --plan-dir reads &lt;dir&gt;/&lt;unit&gt;/tfplan.json instead of running terragrunt,
the layout of terragrunt run --all --json-out-dir.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus move suggest --from <unit> --to <unit> [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `unit` | yes | no |
| `unit` | yes | no |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--draft` | write the draft migration file here instead of stdout | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing --draft file | bool |  |  |  |  |
| `--from` | unit whose planned deletes can be moved, as path or path:workspace (repeatable) | string, repeatable |  |  |  | required |
| `--ignore` | let an attribute differ: KIND:TYPE:ATTR\[:PREFIX\] (repeatable) | string, repeatable |  |  |  |  |
| `--plan-dir` | read plans from &lt;dir&gt;/&lt;unit&gt;/tfplan.json instead of running terragrunt | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--repo` | repository root that unit paths are relative to | string | `.` |  |  |  |
| `--to` | unit whose planned creates can receive a move, as path or path:workspace (repeatable) | string, repeatable |  |  |  | required |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

`--format` accepts `tty`, `plain`, `json`. Without it, the format is `tty` when stdout is a terminal and `plain` otherwise. Formats are described on the [global flags](/cli/global-flags) page.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus move suggest --from live/network --to live/network-sg --to live/network-endpoints
tfcensus move suggest --from live/app --to live/app --ignore json:aws_iam_policy:policy --draft migrations/app.hcl
```
